purpose: Document the authoritative-source boundary for operational-scale validation before 1999 without converting an acquisition limitation into a parser pass.

excludedSession.qualification: The official online chapter-level Oregon Laws collection does not provide authoritative 1997 chapter documents or a machine-retrievable chapter-to-enrolled-bill mapping. Official enrolled measures alone do not establish final Oregon Laws chapter identity. This result is an acquisition/source-availability exclusion, not a parser failure and not a pass.
excludedSession.chapter790Note: Chapter 790 remains explicitly represented in the historical boundary because the official 1997 compilation records it as contingent on voter approval and not compiled; it is not silently removed from the attempted range.

policy.pre1999Disposition: Do not claim operational certification for a pre-1999 session unless authoritative chapter identity and source bytes can be acquired with reproducible provenance. Record unavailable-source sessions as qualified exclusions rather than weakening hard gates.
policy.reopenCondition: A pre-1999 session may be operationally validated if an official Oregon chapter-to-bill index, chapter scan set, or equivalent authoritative archival source becomes reproducibly obtainable.
